title.justification: The paper discusses the development and applications of a cloud-based battery management system which utilizes advanced algorithms.
title.quote: This work will present the Battery Cloud that collects measured battery data from electric vehicles and energy storage systems.

extractions.description: The paper presents a cloud-based battery management system called Battery Cloud, which leverages IoT and cloud computing to enhance battery safety, performance, and economy. It includes methods for state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH) estimation, advanced algorithms for anomaly detection, and potential applications in battery manufacture, recycling, and electric vehicle swaps.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The focus on improving energy storage systems and electric vehicles directly contributes to sustainability by enhancing energy efficiency and supporting renewable energy integration.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Energy storage battery plays a key role in modern interconnected energy networks... leveraging cloud computational power and data storage to improve battery safety, performance, and economy.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on enhancing the efficiency and safety of batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage systems, which are crucial for renewable energy integration and transportation electrification.
primary_category.quote: Energy storage battery plays a key role in modern interconnected energy networks. Recent development of Internet of Things (IoT) has enabled traditional battery management system to evolve into Battery Cloud.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper briefly mentions recycling as a potential application of the Battery Cloud, which aligns with sustainable waste management.
secondary_categories.quote: Potential applications of battery cloud also include areas such as battery manufacture, recycling, and electric vehicle battery swap.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper describes a system that manages and improves the performance of batteries used in energy storage, which is a direct application of Battery Energy Storage System technologies.
primary_sub_category.quote: A Battery Cloud or cloud battery management system leverages the cloud computational power and data storage to improve battery safety, performance, and economy.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The mention of recycling as an application indicates an alignment with waste reduction and management strategies.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Potential applications of battery cloud also include areas such as battery manufacture, recycling, and electric vehicle battery swap.

applications.value: Artificial neural network for SOC estimation
applications.justification: The application of artificial neural networks for SOC estimation is a significant part of the paper's focus on improving battery performance.
applications.quote: Using remote vehicle data, we train and validate an artificial neural network to estimate pack SOC during vehicle charging.

applications.justification: The paper proposes a novel method for early detection of thermal anomalies in batteries, which helps prevent safety issues and improve battery longevity.
applications.quote: A data-driven thermal anomaly detection method is developed. The method can detect unforeseen anomalies such as thermal runaways at the very early stage.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories adequately cover the themes of this paper.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories adequately cover the detailed focus of this paper.
